extraction.Name: Will Justice
extraction.Occupation/Income: Has an income of about $400 per year, inherited land. Shares in Pawnee annuity.
extraction.NOTES: Date and manner of delivery of patent Dec. 4, 1917, Agency office. Patent receipted for: yes. Good health. No property or money accumulated. None dependent upon the Indian for support. The land has not been sold, but has been deeded to two minor children, upon court order. The allottee reserves a life use of the land. Notarized November 28, 1928, Pawnee County, Oklahoma. Commission expires Jan. 31st, 1929.
